rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an individual tree.
Use this more explicit term when referring to trees as woody plants, especially in formal or environmental contexts.

example.english: This wetland preserves many native tree species.
example.traditional: 呢片濕地保留咗好多原生樹木。
